title: PUT /tournaments/:id/rounds/:n/matches/:match/lineups request (also .../lineups/check)
description: Both line-ups of a team match, in either of the desk's two shapes: `a` and `b`, a player id (or null for an empty seat) per board, board 1 first; or `out`, who of each roster sits out, and the roster in board order fills the boards (the desk's 'who sits out' editor). A save rewrites the boards and confirms each side it changed. Answered with match-change-response.schema.json (PUT) or lineups-check-response.schema.json (check).
